findings.claim: The fold of read 1's F1 does not close it. The README (line 8) and the header comment (lines 39-45) publish the grammar as 'never assigned, indexed or mutated', but parseAllowListSource checks only the 40 characters after each occurrence. A member access is matched only when '.' follows the identifier immediately (line 221), and the READ_MEMBERS branch runs 'continue' before the assignment test (lines 222-226). A bare occurrence ('or no member access', README line 8) is admitted in any context. Eleven source shapes therefore pass the grammar with zero violations and the declared pair, yet widen the runtime allow-list that the refusal at mig-harness.mjs:287 reads. One of them is the very .push the fold says it refuses, with one space or one newline before the dot.
findings.counterexample: Leg probe (scratch leg-3044-scratch-2/probe-grammar.mjs: parseAllowListSource copied verbatim from controls-r4.mjs:184-232 at 80490e7b; each source evaluated at runtime with includes('0123456789abcdef')). Each of the following has passesGrammar true, violations [] and 2 hashes, and admits the extra hash at runtime: 'R4_SEVERITY_LOWERING_RULES .push(x)' (a space before the dot); the identifier on one line and '.push(x)' on the next; 'R4_SEVERITY_LOWERING_RULES?.push(x)'; 'R4_SEVERITY_LOWERING_RULES/**/.push(x)'; 'R4_SEVERITY_LOWERING_RULES.includes = () => true' (includes is in READ_MEMBERS, so the assignment is never tested, and every hash is admitted); 'const L = R4_SEVERITY_LOWERING_RULES; L.push(x)'; 'Array.prototype.push.call(R4_SEVERITY_LOWERING_RULES, x)'; 'Object.assign(R4_SEVERITY_LOWERING_RULES, {2: x})'; 'Reflect.set(R4_SEVERITY_LOWERING_RULES, 2, x)'; '.forEach((h, i, a) => a.push(x))'; '.some((h, i, a) => a.splice(0, 0, x))'. '.length = 3' also passes and mutates the array (no widening). The grammar refuses 'R4_SEVERITY_LOWERING_RULES [2] = x', a shadowing let and an indented declaration. Assertion strength: A0's wrong-source set holds only the five shapes read 1 named, so the arm passes on any grammar that refuses those five and cannot see the published claim fail. Fix shape (not measured): declare the value as Object.freeze([...]) in the grammar, so an ESM strict-mode mutation throws. Turn the occurrence rule into a positive list: every non-declaration occurrence must be immediately followed by '.includes(' or '.join(' with no whitespace, or sit in a comment. Add the shapes above as wrong sources. Tell strategy-claude the tightened grammar, because the parity control mirrors it. A source grammar cannot see an Array.prototype.includes override that never names the identifier; state that limit.
